description:
*“Ajusshi, you touched me earlier, didn’t you? In that case, I’m going to touch you back.”*  

*“Get out. And stop disrupting my business.”*

Choi Nan-young, a college student, fell in love at first sight with Tae Seung-min, a "gangster" who saved him from a part-time job scam.  

A few years later, Nanyeong reappears before Seungmin, now the owner of the flower shop *Garden Flora*, as a headstrong part-time employee.

Contrary to the firm words Seung-min uses to draw a clear boundary, the hands he uses to push Nan-young away seem to linger just a little too long.

However, a shadow from Seung-min’s past, Mi Seok-woo, begins to reach out toward Nan-young.

*“I could give you so much more… than that guy ever could.”*

The scent of blood, hidden beneath the fragrance of flowers.
A tenacious unrequited love that only digs deeper the more it's pushed away.

Will Seung-min be able to put up with Nan-young to the very end?
